newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline up $17 on refinery woes, Nymex gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline up $17 on refinery woes, Nymex gains.

text.p: Prompt gasoline values jumped $17 on Monday in the wake of the cat cracker outages reported Friday and despite the confirmed resumption of the Nerefco unit earlier in the day.

Strong gains on the Nymex for unleaded gasoline amid a still tight European market also aided the physical gains that saw a confirmed late afternoon trade at $232 for first half August Eurograde barges.
Even higher offer levels were subsequently rumoured, but no fresh trades at higher values were seen.
Two earlier afternoon Eurograde deals were confirmed done at $230, as was a regular trade at $222.
Rumours of a premium unleaded gasoline cargo sale in the north at $232 for 10,000 tonnes for prompt to August 15 remained unconfirmed amid offers around this level and bid talk in the high $220s.
August swap trades were heard done at $217.50 in the morning, followed by $216.50 and $217 in the afternoon before fresh Nymex-led gains saw rumors of a trade at or around $219.
A September swap trade was heard at $201.50 earlier in the afternoon before values fell back to aroound $200.
